verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS customer data platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency location. The GDPR/CCPA consent and privacy-control material is an adjacent compliance feature, not region selection, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
